name: Synchronize
description: Passes a burn, poison, or paralysis to the Pokémon that inflicted it.

name: Magic Guard
description: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.

name: Levitate
description: Gives full immunity to all Ground-type moves.

name: Heatproof
description: Halves the damage from Fire-type moves.

name: Sturdy
description: It cannot be knocked out with one hit from full HP.

name: Analytic
description: Boosts move power when the Pokémon moves last.

name: Flash Fire
description: Powers up Fire-type moves if hit by one, and blocks them.

name: Flame Body
description: Contact with the Pokémon may burn the attacker.

name: Infiltrate
description: Passes through the target's barrier or substitute.

name: Cute Charm
description: Contact with the Pokémon may cause infatuation.

name: Unaware
description: Ignores the target's stat changes when attacking or defending.

name: Drought
description: Turns the sunlight harsh when the Pokémon enters battle.

name: Snow Warning
description: Summons a hailstorm when the Pokémon enters battle.
